purpose: independent full-chain re-derivation of PASS_P2 candidates d (L6 k9) and i (L7 k10) -- proposal, geometry tier, multiplicity, behavioural tier
independence: every statistic in scripts/51 is re-implemented from its definition. scripts/42, 47, 47b, 48 and 48b were READ to learn the constructions and are not imported; gfdisc.fits is not imported either. The only imported machinery is gfdisc.model (loader, capture hook) and gfdisc.rig (cache-side context sampling, batching, dedupe).

rules.channel_1: layer's raw token-type mean residual, coordinate 1038 dropped (R10)
rules.channel_2: lag+1 robust successor-delta type means (1151-dim; the stored dropped coordinate is asserted to be 1038), fp16 -> float32 -> float64 and pool-centred / unit-normalised in float32, matching 48's casting so that nearest-neighbour memberships are reproducible
rules.closure: max angular gap / (2*pi/k) in channel 1's own top-2 PCA plane about the Kasa circle centre (script 22's gap_ratio); PASS < 2.5, closure first
rules.order: two_channel_rho = max over the 2k cyclic shifts and reflections of Spearman between the two channels' recovered angular ranks, with the seed-fixed random tie-break
rules.cell: proposer-matched conditional cell = EXACT enumeration of all 3,795 seed + (k-1) NN sets in CHANNEL-2 space, conditioned on channel-1 closure. Exact rather than the brief's 20,000 resamples because the draw is a deterministic function of the seed, so 3,795 sets is the whole population.
rules.loo: every single-member drop, re-scored for closure and for rho against the (layer, k-1) cell
rules.frequency_arm: 2000 count-matched k-sets (+-0.25 log10 per member). Reported BOTH as the brief's joint fraction (rho >= the candidate's AND gap < 2.5) and as 48's p99-of-rho rule, since the stored pass_ field was computed under the second
rules.multiplicity: siblings = other seed + (k-1) NN sets at the candidate's (layer, k) that are indistinguishable from it on geometry: rho = 1.0, closure, LOO and the frequency arm
rules.behavioural: h <- h + eps*||h||*t_hat_i at resid_post of layer L at the member's own token position; Delta_i = [logit(succ) - logit(pred)]_steered minus the same unsteered, averaged over that member's prompts
rules.behavioural_PASS: sign consistency >= (k-1)/k at SOME eps in the grid (natural arm) AND mean Delta at eps=0.02 above null (iii)'s p99 AND above ALL of null (i)'s direction means -- 47's rule, unchanged

nulls.i: 10 random unit directions per member, orthogonalised against that member's tangent, at eps=0.02
nulls.ii: the tangent rotated +90 and -90 degrees in plane (the radial directions)
nulls.iii: 50 random k-sets from the pool, each with its own plane, circle, angular order and tangents
nulls.iv: 50 SIBLING sets -- other seed + (k-1) NN assemblies from the same channel-2 cloud that also close. The proposer-matched behavioural null; new here, 47/47b did not have it

rules.anchor: strict-12 at L6 runs first through identical code and must PASS by the rule. Context seeds are NEW, so a bit-match with 47 is not expected and is not the gate; if the anchor does not PASS the run stops and reports.

deviations: NULL PROMPT BUDGET. The brief's prose asks for null (iii) at the full 40-prompt budget; the brief's own arithmetic asks for 12 prompts and 60-80k forwards in 1.5-2 h. Those are inconsistent -- 40 prompts for nulls (iii)+(iv) is ~200k forwards, ~4.5 h at the measured 13 forwards/s, over the cap even at the brief's 30-set fallback (which reduces sets, not prompts). The arithmetic is taken as the operative spec: candidates at 40 prompts, all nulls at 12, 50 sets each for (iii) and (iv), 10 directions for (i). This is also exactly 47's rig, which keeps the anchor comparison meaningful. Each candidate is scored BOTH ways: its 40-prompt mean Delta against the null p99 (47's declared rule and the basis of 47b's stored verdicts) and its matched 12-prompt value against the same p99.
The cluster-like cell is enumerated exactly (3,795 sets) rather than sampled 20,000 times; the enumeration is the population the sampling estimates.
Null (iv) is run for the two candidates, not for the anchor: the anchor's verdict is not at issue and the brief asks for null (iv) on the candidates.
